title: Positive restricted width prevents falsification
statement: Let $T$ be a DNF term on $n$ coordinates and let each coordinate be free, fixed to $1$, or fixed to $-1$. If a positive integer $w$ is at most the restricted width of $T$ under this restriction, then no literal of $T$ is falsified by the restriction.
hypotheses_covered: $w$ is at most the restricted width
